CUSTOM_CHANNELS_CHAT.Settings.ChannelsLi: Comma-separated list of channel names. The 'dados' (rolls) channel is automatically reserved for dice.
CUSTOM_CHANNELS_CHAT.Settings.AutoRouteR: Automatically route all dice rolls to the dedicated #dados tab.
CUSTOM_CHANNELS_CHAT.Settings.EnableDisc: Applies user avatar and clean layout to conversation messages.
